plugin.name: Project Messaging
plugin.description: Law firm, team, and project communication: shared assistant, direct messages, file archiving, and AI references. Currently available for Mainland China accounts only.
tool.project_im_list_conversations.desc: Use when the user asks which group chats or conversations exist, including the project group. List the user's messaging conversations (read-only).
tool.project_im_read_messages.desc: Use when the user asks what a group chat or project group has been discussing, or wants the chat history (get the conversation id from project_im_list_conversations first). Read recent messages of a conversation the user belongs to (read-only).
